polls.description: A powerful new AI model from Anthropic is causing major disruption across government agencies, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies worldwide due to its capabilities and potential risks.
polls.question: Should Anthropic release Mythos despite its dangerous capabilities?

cluster_stories.title: Nervous Indian Fintechs Push Anthropic for Access to Mythos
cluster_stories.summary: India’s major financial technology firms are pushing Anthropic PBC to give them early access to Mythos, the artificial intelligence model that has sparked global fears about a new era of cyberattacks.
cluster_stories.headline: INDIAN FINTECHS PANIC... Demand Early Access to Anthropic's MYTHOS

cluster_stories.title: ECB to Scrutinize Anthropic’s Mythos on Call With Executives
cluster_stories.summary: The European Central Bank is convening a call with the chief risk officers of eurozone lenders to discuss the potential threats from Anthropic’s new artificial intelligence model, as officials look to understand the technology’s potential to exploit vulnerabilities in financial systems.
cluster_stories.headline: EUROPEAN BANKS EMERGENCY CALL Over Anthropic's Mythos AI

cluster_stories.title: Bessent Calls Anthropic’s Mythos a Breakthrough in China AI Race
cluster_stories.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hailed Anthropic PBC’s Mythos as a revolutionary step that will keep America ahead of China in AI, endorsing an industry leader that’s clashed with Washington over its role in military endeavors.
cluster_stories.headline: TREASURY CHIEF HAILS ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS IN CHINA AI RACE

cluster_stories.title: White House chief of staff to meet with Anthropic CEO about dangerous new Mythos model, official says
cluster_stories.summary: The meeting comes after tensions have run hot between the Trump administration and the safety-conscious Anthropic.
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE MEETS ANTHROPIC... DANGEROUS MYTHOS MODEL

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Amodei to Meet Wiles With US Seeking Mythos Access
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei is scheduled to meet on Friday with White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, according to people familiar with the matter, as the Trump administration seeks wider US government access to the company’s powerful new Mythos artificial intelligence model.
cluster_stories.headline: URGENT: Amodei Meets White House... US Seeks Mythos Access

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Mythos: What It Is and What It Is Capable of
cluster_stories.summary: Gregory Allen, senior adviser at CSIS Wadhwani AI Center, examines the capabilities of Anthropic’s Mythos model and how AI is being used by the US military to intensify strikes in the Iran war. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: PENTAGON DEPLOYS ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS... GLOBAL MILITARY AI ESCALATION

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic in talks to give US government access to its Mythos model
cluster_stories.summary: Discussions come despite federal lawsuits over whether the start-up is a national security risk
cluster_stories.headline: PENTAGON TALKS ACCESS to Anthropic's CLASSIFIED Mythos Model

cluster_stories.title: White House Works to Give US Agencies Anthropic Mythos AI
cluster_stories.summary: The US government is preparing to make a version of Anthropic PBC’s powerful new artificial intelligence model available to major federal agencies amid concerns that the tool could sharply increase cybersecurity risk, according to a memo reviewed by Bloomberg News.
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE DEPLOYS Anthropic Mythos to Federal Agencies

cluster_stories.title: The AI Model That Frightens Wall Street
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic's new AI has banks, tech giants and governments scrambling to understand what could change for cybersecurity and the future of the internet. We show why its Mythos model is raising alarms. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS Model FRIGHTENS Wall Street

cluster_stories.title: Cómo Anthropic descubrió que Mythos era demasiado peligroso
cluster_stories.summary: Los propios expertos de la empresa de IA advirtieron que Mythos podría vulnerar los sistemas que sustentan gran parte de la computación moderna. Bancos y agencias gubernamentales se apresuran a evaluar la amenaza.
cluster_stories.headline: MYTHOS TOO DANGEROUS: Anthropic's Own Experts Warn

cluster_stories.title: EU in talks with Anthropic over risks of AI model Mythos
cluster_stories.summary: The EU said Thursday it is in discussions with US AI firm Anthropic over concerns about the capabilities of its latest model, which the company itself worries could be a boon for hackers. But no foreign entities were included, raising concerns about the world's preparedness for a model whose offensive capabilities would not stop at US borders.
cluster_stories.headline: EU CONFRONTS Anthropic Over Dangerous AI Model Mythos

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia’s Huang Says Mythos Shows Need for US-China AI Dialogue
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said that Anthropic PBC’s Mythos breakthrough shows that the US should seek greater cooperation with China so artificial intelligence researchers in the world’s two largest economies can agree on how to safely use the increasingly powerful technology.
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA CEO Calls for US-China AI Dialogue After Anthropic Breakthrough

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic attracts $800 billion valuation offers as revenue hits $30 billion annualised run rate
cluster_stories.summary: In short: Anthropic has received investor offers valuing the company at approximately $800 billion, more than doubling its $380 billion valuation from a $30 billion funding round closed just two months ago. The surge follows an unprecedented revenue trajectory that has taken Anthropic from $1 billion in annualised revenue at the end of 2024 to […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC HITS $800B VALUATION... Revenue Soars

cluster_stories.title: White House and Anthropic hold meetings over Mythos model
cluster_stories.summary: Article URL: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cyv10e1d13po Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47812602 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE Meets with Anthropic Over Mythos Model

cluster_stories.title: Mythos a serious threat but more will follow, Barclays CEO says
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic's frontier AI model Mythos is ​a serious threat ​to the global banking system, and ​it is likely to be followed by similar, even more powerful cyberthreats, Barclays chief executive C S Venkatakrishnan said on ‌Friday.
cluster_stories.headline: BARCLAYS CEO: ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS POSES SERIOUS BANKING THREAT

cluster_stories.title: UK banks get their Mythos briefing within days
cluster_stories.summary: The Bank of England’s Cross Market Operational Resilience Group will convene within days to brief major UK banks, insurers, and exchanges about Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview. This unreleased AI model regulators say can autonomously identify and exploit vulnerabilities across every major operating system and web browser. The US Treasury, the Federal Reserve, and the Bank […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: BANK OF ENGLAND Briefs Banks on Claude Mythos

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Plans to Bring Mythos to UK Banks Within the Next Week
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC is planning to release its closely watched Mythos artificial intelligence model to UK financial institutions in the coming week.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC Brings Mythos to UK Banks Next Week

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic's Mythos to Be Available to UK Banks Within 'Next Week'
cluster_stories.summary: Pip White, Anthropic's head of UK, Ireland and northern Europe, says the firm is planning to release its new Mythos model to UK financial institutions in the coming week. The artificial intelligence developer initially gave Mythos to a handful of Silicon Valley partners and Wall Street banks, arguing that the limited release was necessary because the model was so adept at spotting cybersecurity vulnerabilities. White speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC'S MYTHOS AI HITS UK BANKS WITHIN WEEK

cluster_stories.title: Federal agencies skirt Trump's Anthropic ban to test its advanced AI model: Politico
cluster_stories.summary: US agencies quietly bypass Trump’s ban on Anthropic, as a Commerce Department unit tests its advanced AI model Mythos for hacking capabilities, according to a Politico report.
cluster_stories.headline: FEDERAL AGENCIES SECRETLY BYPASS TRUMP'S ANTHROPIC BAN

cluster_stories.title: White House and Anthropic CEO discuss working together amid rising fear about Mythos model
cluster_stories.summary: The meeting between CEO Dario Amodei and White House staff, which took place amid growing ‌fears the AI ⁠startup's latest model ⁠will supercharge cyberattacks, suggests the two sides might be on a path to rebuilding trust.
cluster_stories.headline: WHITE HOUSE MEETS ANTHROPIC CEO AMID MYTHOS CYBERTHREAT FEARS

polls.description: Anthropic's powerful Mythos AI model is causing widespread concern among governments, banks, and institutions due to safety fears while driving massive adoption.
polls.question: Should Anthropic release Mythos publicly despite cybersecurity risks?
